Test Case Description: Register with valid user data
Expected Result: 201 Created; response contains user id and profile (without password) and email verification required flag if applicable

Test Case Description: Register with existing email
Test Steps: 1) POST /api/auth/register with an email already in DB
Expected Result: 409 Conflict or 400 with message 'email already exists'

Test Case Description: Register with weak password
Test Steps: 1) POST register with password not meeting policy (e.g., '123')
Expected Result: 400 Bad Request with validation error specifying password requirements

Test Case Description: Login with valid credentials
Pre-conditions: User registered and confirmed if required
Expected Result: 200 OK with access token (+ refresh token if implemented) and user info

Test Case Description: Login with wrong password
Test Steps: 1) POST /api/auth/login with correct email, wrong password
Expected Result: 401 Unauthorized with clear error message

Test Case Description: Login with non-existent user
Expected Result: 401 or 404 with proper message

Test Case Description: Refresh access token with valid refresh token
Pre-conditions: User logged in; valid refresh token
Expected Result: 200 OK with new access token (and possibly new refresh token)

Test Case Description: Refresh with invalid/expired token
Expected Result: 401 Unauthorized and token invalid message

Test Case Description: Logout invalidates refresh token
Pre-conditions: User logged in with refresh token
Test Steps: 1) POST /api/auth/logout with refresh token; attempt to refresh afterwards
Expected Result: Logout returns 200; subsequent refresh fails with 401

Test Case Description: Request password reset flow
Pre-conditions: User exists and email service stubbed or accessible
Expected Result: 200 OK and email sent (verify by email queue/log or stub) containing reset link/token

Test Case Description: Get current user profile with valid token
Expected Result: 200 OK with user profile fields but not password

Test Case Description: Update profile with valid data
Test Steps: 1) PUT /api/users/{id} or PUT /api/users/me with new fields
Expected Result: 200 OK and returned profile reflects changes

Test Case Description: Attempt to update other user's profile without permission
Pre-conditions: Authenticated user without admin role; other user exists
Expected Result: 403 Forbidden or 401 if not allowed

Test Case Description: Delete user by admin
Expected Result: 204 No Content or 200 with confirmation; user no longer retrievable

Test Case Description: Delete own account
Expected Result: 204 No Content and further login fails

Test Case Description: Create role as admin
Test Steps: 1) POST /api/roles with role name and permissions
Expected Result: 201 Created and role returned

Test Case Description: Assign role to user
Pre-conditions: User and role exist; admin token
Expected Result: 200 OK; user's roles include new role

Test Case Description: Access protected endpoint without required role
Pre-conditions: User logged in without needed role
Expected Result: 403 Forbidden

Test Case Description: Create course with valid payload
Expected Result: 201 Created and course data returned

Test Case Description: Create course with missing required fields
Expected Result: 400 Bad Request with validation error

Test Case Description: Get course by id
Expected Result: 200 OK with course details

Test Case Description: Update course metadata
Expected Result: 200 OK; returned course reflects changes

Test Case Description: Delete course by admin
Pre-conditions: Admin token; course exists and possibly related quizzes
Expected Result: 204 No Content; related entities either removed or prevented per business rule; GET returns 404

Test Case Description: Create quiz under a course
Expected Result: 201 Created with quiz id and settings

Test Case Description: Create quiz with invalid duration (negative)
Expected Result: 400 Bad Request with validation message

Test Case Description: Publish a quiz (make available)
Expected Result: 200 OK and quiz status = published; students can start it

Test Case Description: Start a quiz session for a student
Pre-conditions: Published quiz; authenticated student; within allowed dates
Expected Result: 201 Created with session id and timer info; cannot start twice if policy prevents

Test Case Description: Start quiz outside allowed window
Test Steps: 1) POST /start when current time outside window
Expected Result: 403 Forbidden or 400 with appropriate message

Test Case Description: Add question to quiz
Test Steps: 1) POST /api/quizzes/{quizId}/questions with question text, type, points
Expected Result: 201 Created and question returned with id

Test Case Description: Add question with missing options for MCQ
Expected Result: 400 Bad Request with validation error

Test Case Description: Add option to question and mark correct
Expected Result: 201 Created and option returned

Test Case Description: Submit question with multiple correct flags when single-correct required
Test Steps: 1) POST options where more than one isCorrect=true
Expected Result: 400 Bad Request or validation error

Test Case Description: Submit answers for an active session
Pre-conditions: User started session and has sessionId
Expected Result: 200 OK with score, correct/incorrect breakdown, time taken

Test Case Description: Submit answers after time expired
Test Steps: 1) POST /submit after allowed time or simulate expired session
Expected Result: 400 or 403 with 'session expired' and no changes to stored result OR partial scoring per rules

Test Case Description: Auto-grade objective questions
Test Steps: 1) Submit answers; check returned score and persisted result
Expected Result: Score computed correctly per answer key; persisted in DB

Test Case Description: Submit subjective answer for manual grading
Test Steps: 1) Student submits subjective answer; instructor PUT grade
Expected Result: Instructor can post grade; final result updated with manual score

Test Case Description: Student retrieves their quiz results
Expected Result: 200 OK with list of attempts and scores, timestamps

Test Case Description: Instructor views all student results for a quiz
Pre-conditions: Instructor token; quiz exists; submissions exist
Expected Result: 200 OK with list of student results, sortable/filtered

Test Case Description: Search courses by title keyword
Expected Result: 200 OK with list of matched courses; paging works

Test Case Description: Verify pagination limits and page parameter
Expected Result: 200 OK with correct items per page and total count metadata

Test Case Description: POST with wrong Content-Type header (text/plain)
Test Steps: 1) POST JSON body but set Content-Type: text/plain
Expected Result: 415 Unsupported Media Type or 400 with helpful error

Test Case Description: Access protected endpoints without Authorization header
Expected Result: 401 Unauthorized

Test Case Description: Attempt Escalation by including role in request body
Pre-conditions: User updates their profile attempting to set role=admin
Expected Result: Server ignores role change or returns 403; no role change in DB

Test Case Description: Delete course and verify quizzes behavior per policy
Pre-conditions: Course with quizzes exists; admin token
Test Steps: 1) DELETE course; GET related quiz or check DB
Expected Result: Quizzes either deleted (cascade) or preserved with null course per spec; no orphaned inaccessible references

Test Case Description: Upload image/resource for question or course
Expected Result: 201 Created with file URL; file accessible by GET with proper permissions

Test Case Description: Upload unsupported file type (e.g., .exe)
Expected Result: 400 Bad Request or 415 Unsupported Media Type; file not stored

Test Case Description: Verify response JSON schema for key endpoints
Test Steps: 1) Call endpoints (login, course list, quiz start) and validate fields and types
Expected Result: Responses match documented schema; required fields present

Test Case Description: Submit answers concurrently from same user/session
Pre-conditions: Active session allowing single submit normally
Expected Result: Single accepted per business rule; no double-scoring or inconsistent state; appropriate error for duplicates

Test Case Description: Exceed allowed requests threshold from one IP
Test Steps: 1) Send many requests per second to login or public endpoints
Expected Result: After threshold, receive 429 Too Many Requests and Retry-After header

Test Case Description: API should respond within SLA (e.g., < 500ms) under normal load
Test Steps: 1) Measure response time for GET /courses multiple times
Expected Result: 95th percentile response < SLA; no errors

Test Case Description: Attempt SQL injection via input fields
Test Steps: 1) Send ' OR 1=1 -- in search or form fields
Expected Result: No leakage of data; input sanitized; DB errors not exposed; 400 or 200 with safe behavior

Test Case Description: Attempt stored XSS via question/course titles
Pre-conditions: Authenticated instructor able to create content
Test Steps: 1) POST content with <script>alert(1)</script> in title; then GET as student
Expected Result: Stored script should be escaped in responses or removed; no script execution in client context

Test Case Description: Test CSRF protections for state-changing endpoints (if cookie auth)
Test Steps: 1) Send cross-origin POST with cookies from malicious origin
Expected Result: Server rejects request (CORS, CSRF token missing) or state not changed

Test Case Description: Trigger server error and check logs and response
Test Steps: 1) Send malformed request to cause 500 (if reproducible safely)
Expected Result: 500 returned with generic error message (no sensitive info); detailed error recorded in server logs

Test Case Description: Submit and retrieve Unicode content (emojis, accents)
Expected Result: Unicode preserved and correctly returned in responses

Test Case Description: Submit a very large request body near max payload
Test Steps: 1) POST with very large JSON (> allowed)
Expected Result: 413 Payload Too Large or 400; server stable

Test Case Description: Verify data persists after server restart
Test Steps: 1) Create course/quiz; restart backend; GET created resources
Expected Result: Created resources still available (persistence verified)

Test Case Description: Verify transactional emails (registration, reset) content and links
Expected Result: Email sent with correct template, working links/tokens and no sensitive tokens in URL if not allowed

Test Case Description: Verify audit logs for critical actions (create/delete quiz)
Test Steps: 1) Perform action (DELETE quiz); check audit endpoint or logs
Expected Result: Audit record exists with actor, timestamp, action and target id

Test Case Description: Call deprecated endpoint version missing required changes
Test Steps: 1) Call v1 endpoint that changed in v2
Expected Result: Server returns 301/410 or supports versioning per spec; client informed

Test Case Description: Ensure validation errors are descriptive and actionable
Test Steps: 1) POST invalid data to various endpoints
Expected Result: 400 responses include field-level errors with messages to fix

Test Case Description: Get resource list when none exist
Pre-conditions: Clean DB or no records for resource
Expected Result: 200 OK with empty array and totalCount=0 or appropriate metadata

Test Case Description: Export quiz/report data (CSV/JSON)
Pre-conditions: User with export permissions; data exists
Expected Result: 200 OK with downloadable file and correct content

Test Case Description: Check /health or /status endpoint
Expected Result: 200 OK with service status and optional subsystems (DB, cache) status
